description.en: Grimm collects the fairy tales people grow up with. He has summoned you to help when their stories go wrong. Explore the village, run supplies, train and meet Eir. Later stories still contain original Chinese dialogue and artwork.
description.zh-CN: 格林收集着各国陪伴人们长大的童话。故事出了乱子，他召唤你前来帮忙。先在村中准备、出村补给、训练，再结识埃尔。中后期故事仍有原版对白和美术，正在逐批改写。

description.en: Grimm has made room among his notebooks for a visitor. The chair is clear; the desk has lost that battle.
description.zh-CN: 格林从笔记堆里给客人腾出了一把椅子。书桌就没这么走运了。

description.en: Grimm is still reading where you left him. There is always another story to discuss.
description.zh-CN: 你回到格林的居所。他仍在翻阅故事册，等着听你旅途上的见闻。

description.en: A village with a patient instructor, a practical shopkeeper, and a dummy that takes its work personally.
description.zh-CN: 村里有位耐心有限的教官、一位算账清楚的店主，还有个对工作很认真的训练假人。

guideLocation.en: Grimm, collector of tales and reluctant volunteer for sword practice.
guideLocation.zh-CN: 格林：收集故事很在行，提剑上阵另当别论。

houseLocation.en: Grimm's home. Speak with him or continue your preparations.
houseLocation.zh-CN: 格林的居所，可以向他请教，或继续准备旅程。

tutorial.en: Ask Grimm about leaving the village
tutorial.zh-CN: 找格林出村，接下买药教学

team.en: Return to Grimm's home for team practice
team.zh-CN: 回格林居所完成结伴练习

training.zh-CN: 完成一次入门实战练习

equipment.en: Put on a piece of equipment

en: A cottage full of books. Am I safe, or about to be assigned reading?
zh-CN: 一间堆满书的屋子。我这是得救了，还是要交读书报告？

点击人物头像，即可触发与人物交互。.en: Select Grimm's portrait to speak with him.
点击人物头像，即可触发与人物交互。.zh-CN: 点击格林的头像，就能与他交谈。

再次来到金庸十四天书的世界。.en: Grimm needs help with tales that have stalled. First: learn enough to survive my own first chapter.
再次来到金庸十四天书的世界。.zh-CN: 格林请我帮助那些停在半途的童话。首先，学点本领，别让自己的故事停在开头。

点击人物状态栏，点击修炼，可以装备内功入门。.en: Open Training and select Steadfast Mastery Scroll.
点击人物状态栏，点击修炼，可以装备内功入门。.zh-CN: 打开人物状态栏的“修炼”，选入《坚毅专精卷轴》。

装备上的武学经书，在战斗结束后能将获得的经验快速分配到该项武学上，可以迅速提升武.en: A selected training scroll receives battle experience. Reading alone will not frighten the dummy.
装备上的武学经书，在战斗结束后能将获得的经验快速分配到该项武学上，可以迅速提升武.zh-CN: 选入修炼栏的卷轴会获得战斗经验。只捧着书看，可吓不倒训练假人。

入门体验告一段落。原版买药教学、门派选择和其他江湖地点已逐步接入；可继续完成南贤.en: That is how two travelers become a team. Review your opening-chapter goals and save your journey. More stories await beyond this field trial; those later chapters are still being rewritten.
入门体验告一段落。原版买药教学、门派选择和其他江湖地点已逐步接入；可继续完成南贤.zh-CN: 两个旅人就这样成为了搭档。检查前期章节目标，再保存这段旅程。实地委托之外还有更多故事，后续章节仍在逐批改写。

text.en: I'm Grimm. I collect the fairy tales people grow up with. Here, their roads run into one another.
text.zh-CN: 我是格林，收集各国陪伴人们长大的童话。在这里，故事里的道路会通向彼此。

text.en: You summoned me here? So which way do I go?
text.zh-CN: 是你把我召唤来的？那我该往哪儿走？

text.en: Some stories have lost their way. I could use your help getting them moving again.
text.zh-CN: 有些故事出了点岔子，我想请你帮个忙，让它们继续往前走。

text.en: Explore, find companions, and learn a few tricks. There's no single road you have to follow.
text.zh-CN: 四处看看，结识伙伴，再学几手本领。接下来走哪条路，由你自己选。

text.en: An open road and interesting company? I'm in.
text.zh-CN: 有路可走，也有有趣的人作伴？那就出发吧。

text.en: Then take this beginner's scroll. Start in the village, and bring me a good story.
text.zh-CN: 先拿上这本入门卷轴，从村里开始吧。记得回来，给我讲讲你的见闻。

text.en: Take this Steadfast Mastery Scroll. Sound foundations first; the dramatic entrances can wait.
text.zh-CN: 拿好坚毅专精卷轴。先打稳基础，威风的登场可以晚点再练。

text.en: A useful start. I'll take a look around.
text.zh-CN: 那就从这里开始吧。我先到处看看。

text.en: Off you go. Listen to people, watch your footing, and do come back with a story. Preferably in person.
text.zh-CN: 去吧。多听别人说话，也多看看脚下。记得回来讲故事，最好是本人回来。

text.en: People remember what you do. Help them, and your reputation grows. Hurt them, and that travels too.
text.zh-CN: 人们会记住你的行为。帮过谁，会留下好名声；伤过谁，消息也一样传得开。

text.en: What if the villain gives a very convincing speech?
text.zh-CN: 要是坏人说得特别有道理呢？

text.en: Listen carefully. Especially when he explains why stealing your boots is for your own good.
text.zh-CN: 那就更得仔细听了。尤其是他开始解释，偷走你的靴子其实是为你好。

text.en: Companions have troubles of their own. Help them through those, and some will join you.
text.zh-CN: 伙伴也有自己的难处。帮他们走过那段故事，有些人才愿意与你同行。

text.en: Your choices matter. It's hard to earn someone's trust after selling their family heirloom.
text.zh-CN: 你的选择很要紧。刚卖掉人家的传家宝，再谈信任，通常有点晚。

text.en: Look in inns as well. Completing a journey can also unlock starting companions for a later round.
text.zh-CN: 旅馆也值得逛逛。完成一轮旅程后，下一周目还可能解锁特别的开局伙伴。

text.en: Some found a calling. Some found friends. One spent an alarming amount of time sorting his luggage.
text.zh-CN: 有的找到了志向，有的找到了朋友。还有一位，把大半旅程花在整理行李上。

text.en: Were they all heroes?
text.zh-CN: 他们最后都成英雄了吗？

text.en: Eventually, some of them. Nobody starts with a statue. You have time.
text.zh-CN: 有些后来是。谁出门的时候，也不是扛着自己的雕像走的。你还有时间。

text.en: And what, exactly, am I collecting?
text.zh-CN: 所以，我到底该收集什么？

text.en: The tales people grew up with, from different lands. Find the people caught in them and help their stories continue.
text.zh-CN: 各国陪伴人们长大的那些童话。找到被困在故事里的人，帮他们把故事继续下去。

text.en: Make friends, learn their skills, and bring me your adventures. Leave their silverware where it's.
text.zh-CN: 结识伙伴，学习本领，把见闻带回来。人家的银餐具，就留在人家家里。

text.en: A writer must know a few sharp moves.
text.zh-CN: 写故事的人，总该有几招厉害的吧？

text.en: My strongest blow is a revision. The instructor offers a more practical demonstration.
text.zh-CN: 我最狠的一招是删稿。你想练实用的，还是去找教官。

text.en: Right. I would prefer to remain in the story.
text.zh-CN: 懂了。我暂时还想留在故事里。

text.en: Grimm's new traveler? Good. Put your feet there. No, both of them.
text.zh-CN: 格林新找来的旅人？好，把脚站稳。对，两只脚都得站稳。

text.en: Do I look that inexperienced?
text.zh-CN: 我看起来有那么生疏吗？

text.en: You walked into the practice yard smiling. We can work on that.
text.zh-CN: 你进练武场的时候还带着笑。没关系，咱们慢慢教。

text.en: Attacks are the techniques you use on the field. Learn a useful mix; ten answers to the same problem are still one answer.
text.zh-CN: 魔法与战技是战场上主动使出的本领。搭配要实用，十招都解决同一个问题，遇上别的问题还是没辙。

text.en: Passive masteries strengthen your fighting. You can learn several; some benefits require one to be equipped.
text.zh-CN: 被动专精能强化战斗能力，可以学习多种；部分效果需要装备为当前主专精才生效。

text.en: Some trained skills unlock finishers, often powered by rage. Personal special abilities offer other tactical effects.
text.zh-CN: 有些技能练到一定程度会解锁绝技，往往需要怒气。角色特有的特殊技能，则提供不同的战术效果。

text.en: Gauntlets, swords, blades and spells reward different training. Choose a direction; your pack does not need to contain an entire armory.
text.zh-CN: 拳套、剑术、重武器和法术各有专长。先选个方向，背包里不必塞进整座兵器库。

text.en: Talents give people their particular strengths. Some are born with them; some can be learned.
text.zh-CN: 天赋决定每个人的独特长处。有些生来就有，有些可以后天学会。

text.en: Read the effects. A talent can improve accuracy, reduce damage, or change how a whole team fights.
text.zh-CN: 仔细看实际效果。它可能提高命中、减少伤害，也可能改变全队的打法。

text.en: Not every talent is helpful. An impressive title is not the same as a recommendation.
text.zh-CN: 也不是每个天赋都有好处。名字听着威风，并不代表值得夸奖。

text.en: Schools teach advanced techniques through their own tasks. Earn their trust, and the better lessons follow.
text.zh-CN: 学派通常会通过任务传授高深本领。先赢得信任，才有后面的课。

text.en: Experienced travelers can teach you too. Try speaking to them before testing whether their beard is real.
text.zh-CN: 旅途中的高手也可能指点你。先好好说话，别一见面就上手试人家的胡子是真是假。

text.en: Attacks can favor Radiant or Umbral affinity. Your equipped mastery supplies those affinities, so check the pairing.
text.zh-CN: 攻击分为光辉与幽影亲和。当前运用的被动专精提供对应加成，搭配之前先看看数值。

text.en: Radiant attacks use Radiant affinity; Umbral attacks use Umbral affinity. Balanced attacks use whichever value is higher.
text.zh-CN: 光辉攻击取光辉亲和，幽影攻击取幽影亲和；平衡攻击取两者中较高的值。

text.en: A fine technique with the wrong mastery is a fine technique having a disappointing afternoon.
text.zh-CN: 招式再漂亮，被动专精没配好，也只能漂亮地吃亏。

text.en: Check the enemy's reach before moving. Spreading out can keep one attack from hitting your whole party.
text.zh-CN: 移动前先看敌人的攻击范围。适当分散，别让一招把全队都扫进去。

text.en: Watch skill costs and choose the right moment to attack, defend, heal, or weaken an opponent.
text.zh-CN: 看清技能消耗，再决定该进攻、防守、治疗，还是先削弱对手。

text.en: Bring companions who cover one another's weaknesses. Four people with the same blind spot are a queue.
text.zh-CN: 带上能互补的伙伴。四个人都有同一个破绽，那叫排队挨打。

text.en: Auto can handle routine fights. When things get difficult, take over and choose your moves yourself. Luck helps; a plan helps more.
text.zh-CN: 简单战斗可以交给自动。难打时就接手，自己选走位和招式。运气有用，想好怎么打更有用。

text.en: Training raises a skill to its current limit. Raising that limit takes something extra.
text.zh-CN: 修炼能把技能练到当前上限。想突破上限，还得有额外的收获。

text.en: Certain battles drop fragments, and some encounters grant breakthroughs. Check which skill a reward actually improves.
text.zh-CN: 有些战斗会掉落残章，有些奇遇会给予突破。先看清奖励究竟提升哪项技能。

text.en: A one-time reward stays one-time. Asking again with a different hat does not make you a new pupil.
text.zh-CN: 一次性的奖励，就只能领一次。换顶帽子再来，也不能算新学生。

text.en: Keep your guard up. The dummy is wooden, but it still hits back.
text.zh-CN: 护好自己。那假人是木头做的，可它照样会还手。

text.en: Useful information before I try shaking its hand.
text.zh-CN: 幸好你先说了，我差点过去跟它握手。

text.en: At level five and beyond, you need tougher practice. Leave this one for beginners. And for the carpenter's peace of mind.
text.zh-CN: 到了五级，就该找更强的对手练了。这个留给新人，也让村里的木匠安稳两天。

text.en: Welcome. Supplies on the shelves; heroic speeches outside. I've stock to count.
text.zh-CN: 欢迎。补给在货架上，豪言壮语请到门外说。我还得盘货。

text.en: Choose an item to check its price and effects before buying. A dramatic destiny is not accepted currency.
text.zh-CN: 买之前先看价格和效果。你肩负多大的命运，都不能拿来抵账。

text.en: I buy spare items too. Check the sale price first; fond memories are sadly non-refundable.
text.zh-CN: 多余的东西我也收。先看回收价——至于你对它的感情，这边实在折不了现。

text.en: Time to practice together. If we both shout 'I've got this', one of us still needs to watch the flank.
text.zh-CN: 该一起练练了。就算两个人都喊“交给我”，也总得有一个记得看侧翼。

prompt.en: Before you go: questions are free. Answers may involve homework.
prompt.zh-CN: 出发前还有什么想问？提问免费，答案可能附带功课。

en: [Set out] I'm ready for the road.
[Ask] How much do my choices matter?
[Ask] What became of your other travelers?
[Ask] Remind me what I'm here to do.
[Spar] Surely a writer knows a few sharp moves.
zh-CN: 【询问】我的选择会有什么影响？
【询问】你以前遇到的旅人，后来怎样了？
【切磋】写故事的人，应该也有两招吧？

prompt.en: What needs work: your technique, your tactics, or your confidence?
prompt.zh-CN: 想练哪样：招式、战术，还是你那份自信？

en: [Spar] Let me try the training dummy.
How do attacks and masterys work?
Where can I learn advanced techniques?
How do Radiant and Umbral affinities work?
What should I do when a fight gets difficult?
How do I raise a skill's level limit?
zh-CN: 招式和被动专精该怎么搭配？
去哪里学更高深的本领？
光辉和幽影亲和怎样影响攻击？
碰上难打的敌人怎么办？
怎样提高技能等级上限？

description.en: Practical lessons. The bruises are included.
description.zh-CN: 教实用本领，淤青不另收费。

description.en: Useful supplies, priced individually. Destiny is not legal tender.
description.zh-CN: 旅途用品，明码标价。天命不能抵账。

description.en: An old shrine at the edge of the village.
description.zh-CN: 村边的一座旧祠。

description.en: Meet the instructor or visit the supply shop.
description.zh-CN: 去见教官，或到杂货铺准备行装。

description.en: Return to the world map.
description.zh-CN: 返回世界地图。

description.en: A veteran of countless practice sessions. Still refuses to give interviews.
description.zh-CN: 身经百练，至今拒绝接受采访。

description.en: Practice fighting alongside your companion.
description.zh-CN: 与伙伴练习配合作战。

description.en: Take stock before the next stretch of road.
description.zh-CN: 回顾收获，准备下一段路。

description.en: Back to the road.
description.zh-CN: 重新上路。

description.en: Study this scroll to learn Steadfast Mastery through combat XP. Select your equipped mastery separately.
description.zh-CN: 研习此卷轴，通过战斗经验学习坚毅专精；当前装备的主专精另行选择。

description.en: Keeps the sun off your head. The heroism is up to you. Its attribute and talent effects are listed below.
description.zh-CN: 负责遮阳，不负责让你英姿勃发。属性与天赋效果见下方说明。

description.en: Restores 600 HP. For injuries; wounded pride may take longer.
description.zh-CN: 恢复600点生命。治疗伤势，至于受伤的自尊，可能还得缓一缓。

description.en: Restores 1,000 Health plus 10% of maximum Health. Item cooldowns apply above Normal difficulty.
description.zh-CN: 恢复1000点生命，并额外恢复最大生命的10%。高于普通难度时启用物品冷却。

description.en: Restores 1,600 HP. Rare herbs, a strong dose, and no interesting flavour.
description.zh-CN: 恢复1600点生命。药材珍贵，药效充足，味道不值得期待。

description.en: Restores 300 HP and 300 energy. Finally, a remedy that belongs in a picnic basket.
description.zh-CN: 恢复300点生命和300点能量。总算有一样补给适合放进野餐篮了。

description.en: A gauntlet technique with a major power increase at rank 10. Its unpolished appearance hides room to grow. Check the current costs and range in battle.
description.zh-CN: 10级时威力大幅提升的拳套战技。动作朴实，成长空间却不小。实际消耗与距离请在战斗中查看。

description.en: A passive mastery that strengthens your foundations. Select it as your equipped mastery separately from scroll study.
description.zh-CN: 巩固基础的被动专精。卷轴研习与当前装备的主专精分别设置。
